observations: Self-flagged margin «à vérifier» covers the quotient construction. The top assertion is attributed to an uncertain name (Lazard/ Laborde) and contrasted with failure for classifying topoi B_O(n), n>=1. A cancelled criterion is replaced on the same page by the stabilized condition with alpha(F). The final explicit question asks whether the pre-lambda structure of WG(S) descends to W(S). The NB invokes a «th de Witt» for cancellation; no proof is supplied here.

audit.notes: Whole page re-read. Enlargement of personal name favours Laborde (looped b and final de); Lazard retained as alternative. Removed underline generated by descender in signifie. Cancellation and insertion alpha(E), and à vérifier margin, rechecked.
